name: kplus_entry
notes: MZ entry: copies A35Ch bytes of the cave to L+7E00h, pool fix, enters OS 3.16; moves L>6900h down first

name: kplus_mover
notes: Moves the image from L>6900h to 6900h with the table at 7E00:A49C, then re-enters

name: kplus_mover_params
notes: Paragraphs to move (7465h), table entries (1D10h), minimum move (01FCh)

name: kplus_reloc_table
notes: Byte/word-delta relocation list (7439 fix-ups + one 64 KiB skip); ends at the end of the file

name: kplus_banner
notes: 3K PLUS 1.0

name: kplus_resident_end
notes: First byte not copied home; RAM from logical F135C is not referenced by the cave (static)

name: scsi_reader_wrapper
notes: Runs scsi_partition_reader on a private 1200h stack at pool_end+1 (below the OS)

name: sound_free_hook
notes: sound_free entry hook: clears zone state when the zone source is freed, continues at 21E7:0B25

name: midi_remote_key_bits
notes: MIDI Remote key bitmap; index (byte-40h)>>3 has no upper bound (up to A363 for bytes >= 80h)

name: program_init_wrapper
notes: Hooked from 207C:02D3: clears the program's mute groups, then OS 3.16 program_init

name: program_copy_wrapper
notes: Hooked from 19F9: copies mute groups with the program

name: zones_to_program_page
notes: Lazy Chop <To program> page

name: to_program_execute
notes: Make Sounds, wipe+rename, select, assign zone i -> slot i, summary

name: to_program_assign_loop
notes: Assignment loop (zone i -> pad slot i), ends at 6286

name: make_zone_sounds
notes: One Sound per zone; checks before allocation; frees on failure; result in cs:26BA

name: zone_sound_name
notes: Base name + number; +100 while sound_find finds the name

name: program_record_or_none
notes: AL program -> ES:BX record, ZF=1 if none

name: program_is_empty
notes: AL program -> ZF=1 if all 64 entries are FFh

name: next_empty_program
notes: Default destination: next empty program after the current one

name: do_it_stamp
notes: Drop queued Enter/exit/Do-it keys, stamp tick time

name: do_it_guard
notes: CF=0 when 100 ticks of DS:D38C passed since the stamp

name: mute_group_enable
notes: AL program, DL 0/1: groups on/off

name: mute_group_set
notes: AL program, BL pad slot, DL group 0-4

name: mute_group_table
notes: 24 x 21h: on flag, then one nibble per pad slot

name: mute_trailer_headers
notes: MUTEGP35 headers for PGM (type 1) and APS (type 2)

name: mute_trailer_read
notes: Read and check the trailer, copy into the table, close

name: mute_trailer_write
notes: Write header and table data, close

name: zp_dest_program
notes: Zones to Program: destination program 0-23

name: zp_mute_group
notes: Zones to Program: mute group 0=OFF,1-4

name: zp_field
notes: Zones to Program: cursor field 0-1

name: zp_skipped
notes: Zones not placed (Pads skipped)

name: zp_new_sounds
notes: New Sound number per zone

name: zone_count
notes: Number of zones 1-64

name: zone_table
notes: Zones: start and end frames, 8 bytes each

name: tick_counter
notes: Incremented by the vector-08h handler (2B50:0028)

name: program_table
notes: Word record size, word program count (both set at run time), records from +4

name: program_init
notes: Initialise a program record (hooked by 3K PLUS at its first bytes)

name: program_entry_init
notes: Initialise one 18h-byte per-note entry; byte 0 = FFh (no Sound)

name: pad_note_set
notes: (slot, note): clamps note to 22h-62h; global or program map by DS:8063

name: pad_assign_mode
notes: Assign Pads Mode: 0 PROGRAM, 1 MASTER

name: current_program_record
notes: Far pointer to the current program record (set by program_select)

name: kplus_note_first_pad
notes: Note -> first pad slot, honours DS:8063

name: program_record
notes: OS 3.16 routine, unchanged in 3K PLUS

name: program_select
notes: OS 3.16; sets DS:E2E6/E2E8 and DS:E2FB

name: pad_note_effective
notes: OS 3.16; slot>=40h -> 23h; MASTER global map; PROGRAM record+73Eh
